label: R Draconis

detectors.position_rule: follows Gaia DR3 1648328016354496384 (proper motion, straight line)
detectors.reason: The star's saturated (no-value) core reaches 6.2 px from its centre in at least one exposure. Measuring the light around it would need a ring starting at 7 px, and only rings starting at most 3 px out were checked to follow a star's brightness (RW Aur, 3-6 px: about 10%). So no light curve is given.

visit_rule: exposures closer than 30 days in a row, at most 60 days per visit (archive.group_epochs)
warnings: No frames prepared for D1, D3, D4, D5, D6, so those wavelengths are missing.

D2: no points. The star's saturated (no-value) core reaches 6.2 px from its centre in at least one exposure. Measuring the light around it would need a ring starting at 7 px, and only rings starting at most 3 px out were checked to follow a star's brightness (RW Aur, 3-6 px: about 10%). So no light curve is given.
method: every point comes from one detector's lightcurve.json (backend/app/lightcurve.py); points of all detectors grouped into visits by time
